messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: service=redis | symptom=maxclients_exceeded | env=prod | severity=high
pagerduty: Page fired to #sre_oncall and @alice SRE (primary). Incident key: pd_inc_1945678901. Auto-escalation in 10m if not acked.
alice SRE: acked. I'm on it — looking at redis telemetry now.
alice SRE: grafana shows connection count spike at 19:02 UTC, ~13k connections vs usual 500. latency and resp_errors increase.
elaine Eng: seeing 502s from the /v1/embed batch worker in logs, lots of "ERR max number of clients reached" from redis client.
ben DB: also watching pg connections — small surge but within pool. main issue looks like redis pool exhaustion.
carol Support: customer-impact: increased error rates for hosted-API embed and rerank calls. Support queue has ~25 recent tickets marked "embed failures".
alice SRE: quick triage plan: 1) throttle batch-embed workers via debug flag, 2) open new redis replica (read-only) and failover the ephemeral cache keyspace, 3) temporarily bump maxclients (if safe), 4) handoff once stable.
elaine Eng: patch ready to gate worker concurrency: env var EMBED_PARALLELISM=2. Pushing now to canary.
incident-bot: deploy-bot detected new deploy: embed-worker @main -> canary. Change: EMBED_PARALLELISM=2.
alice SRE: canary looks good — error rate down in canary deploy. Rolling to 10% then 100%.
ben DB: redis metrics: maxclients currently at 10k on primary. We can bump to 18k but need to watch file descriptors on host. Initiating increase on redis-primary (config set maxclients 18000).
alice SRE: increased. Clients count dropped as some clients retried/backed off. Latency back to baseline ~50ms. Errors reduced by ~92%.
elaine Eng: why did the worker spike? tracing shows a flurry of retries from legacy batch job that was retriggered by a scheduler bug at 18:58 UTC — duplicate jobs queued. I pushed a scheduler fix to prevent duplicates.
carol Support: updating customers: note created for impacted API users, tentative root cause scheduler duplicates causing connection flood to cache.
alice SRE: preparing handoff: stable for 5m, error rate trending down but we still have elevated connection count vs steady-state. I'm handing to @david SRE for watch and post-incident follow-up.
david SRE: taking over. quick summary: redis maxclients hit due to duplicate batch jobs -> worker concurrency spike -> embed and rerank errors. Mitigations applied: worker concurrency reduced, redis maxclients temporarily raised, scheduler dedupe patch deployed, added a temporary secondary redis replica to absorb read traffic.
david SRE: next actions (post-incident): 1) rollback temp maxclients bump after verifying FD headroom, 2) add circuit-breaker in embed client to limit new connections when redis errors spike, 3) automated detection rule for "sudden client count growth" with PD page threshold.
david SRE: assigning follow-ups to owners: elaine -> scheduler rate-limiter (P1), ben -> verify redis host FD slack (P2), alice -> write incident blameless doc (P2).
ben DB: noted. I'll run FD capacity and schedule move to larger instance if needed.
alice SRE: adding a short incident summary here for the record and for Support to publish. Will open postmortem doc and link.
carol Support: thanks — ping me when the postmortem doc exists so I can finalize customer comms.
david SRE: leaving on-call note: monitoring rule created for redis client_count delta > 2000 over 1m -> PD page. Will tune alert thresholds.
incident-bot: PagerDuty note: incident pd_inc_1945678901 transitioned to "resolved" by david SRE at 19:00 UTC (after mitigations and stable metrics).
david SRE: closing thread for now. If anything regresses, re-open with new PD page. :white_check_mark:
